segments.en:
Grados City
Terran Residential Quarter

Aw, man...
I quiiit!!
No! You have to read it properly!
Miss Anna... Reading books won't ever help us beat those guys!
Never mind that, just read it!
No way! "The pen is mightier than the sword"? That's a big fat lie! Take that!

Ah...
Wait right there!
Oh...
That boy's not the only one who feels that way.
Maybe all we're really doing is just distracting ourselves...
Even so, the reason I take part in all this...
Apart from our aim of saving as many books... as many records as we can... and passing them on to the next generation... is that I'm afraid...
Afraid...?
Once they forbid us from thinking for ourselves...
...they'll brainwash us without our even noticing... That's what I'm afraid of...
I feel the same way...
That's exactly why! We must win over as many comrades as we can
and fight on a different front from armed struggle...
Even if it's unglamorous... even if it doesn't work right away, we have to keep on fighting!
They're here! It's them!!
Everyone! Hide the books, quick!!
All of you, stop working!!
I am Karla Egiel!
If you don't want to die, listen carefully to what I say!
This continent is now being reborn through the civilization of Grados.
The relics of your inferior civilization must be disposed of at once!
Accordingly, all books, tapes, videos, films, paintings... other than those approved by Grados...
...may not be possessed under any circumstances!
However, I have received reports of gatherings held in this area in violation of that law.
Anyone who knows anything will cooperate with our investigation!
Hm? You there, you're awfully absorbed in your work... You wouldn't know anything, would you?
Ah... I know nothing, ma'am...
Can you not look me in the eye when you speak?
...My apologies. My eyes... do not see very well, you see...
Hmph! Search the floor under that old geezer!
Yes, ma'am!
P-Please, stop!
Out of the way!!
Aaah!
Here they are!!
Well, well... and what is the meaning of this huge pile of books?
Not content with hiding them, it seems you were even copying them out?
Uuugh...
Ah, those are...!
What's this? Who are you?
Um... those books...... they're all mine!
The people here have nothing to do with it! I was the one collecting them!
Girl! You're telling me... all of this... belongs to you?
Yes...
...Very well! Have it your way.
But... everyone here will have to answer for this.
No! I don't care what you do to me!
But please, don't punish the others!!
You think a plea like that will be granted?
If the people here lose the work they have now... they won't be able to survive past tomorrow!
If you must punish someone... punish only me!! I beg you!!
...Well, all right. Whether it's a lie or the truth, a thorough interrogation will tell.
Arrest only this girl!
Yes, ma'am!!

Ah...!
Anna!
You bastard! Let go of Miss Anna!!
Hey! You're in the way!!
Waaaaah!!
Lady Karla, was it all right not to arrest them all?
It doesn't matter. I will execute this girl as an example.
You there, girl! What is your name?
My name is Anna Stephanie...
Anna, consider this a special mercy on my part.
Yes... thank you, Lady Karla.
Good! Take her away!
Waaaaah! Miss Annaaaa!!

segments.en: Resistance Secret Base

Whoaaa~!
It's huge~!
Amazing~ Who'd have thought there'd be a facility like this underground?
This is more like an army base than a Resistance hideout...

Resistance Base
"Temporary Command Center"
Welcome to California Base!
On behalf of the whole Resistance, we welcome you all!
I'm "Rain Mikamura," the vice-commander of this base.
And I'm the captain, "Elchi Cargo." Nice to meet you!
Oh my! So you're Captain Elchi? You're even cuter than the rumors said.

Huh?
Oh, stop it~
Hee hee. Nice to meet you, Elchi.
Likewise.

rows.notes: Seg 3: 'Resistance' capitalized as in the previous table. Seg 12: Elchi's [jp] = 'Likewise.'

segments.en: (So this is the lounge...)
(Feels a little bleak, though...)
Yoo-hoo! Long time no see, Kanji!
Whoa!!
Kanji... You know her?
Yeah...
I'm Chan Agi, chief of the maintenance crew.
If there's anything you need, just say the word!
Oh, really? I'll be counting on you, then.
By the way... Isn't Lieutenant Amuro here?
Oh, Amuro's in the hangar doing maintenance on the Gundam.
Hee hee! Sounds like he hasn't changed.
Well, see you later!
Chan has rejoined the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 1: the indent space on the thought's 2nd line not carried over. Seg 9: [jp] = 'Captain Amuro' (form used in an earlier slice). Seg 13: system message, 'rejoined your unit' as in the previous table. | [accuracy 9] [jp]: project decision [jp] = Captain (the row note also says Captain; English had Lieutenant) | [editorial 13] system message aligned to '<name> has joined the unit.' form (matches 'Eiji has rejoined the unit.')

segments.en:
Kanji...
It was Kanji, wasn't it?

Oh, yes.
What is it?
So you knew Chan?
Yeah, she was originally our unit's mechanic.
I see...! Then there shouldn't be any trouble.
By the way, Rain, where's Master?
Huh? Didn't Master come with you?
Domon's master...?
I mean the commander of this base.
But that's odd... He was supposed to be following right behind you...
What?
Fwahahahahahaha! Not to notice me all this time--what a fool you are!

Huh...!
Master?!
Where are you looking?!
I am here! Right here!!
Toaaahhh!!
Master!!

HAAAAAH!
Answer me, Domon!
Th-That's... the Undefeated of the East! Master Asia!!

Fwahahaha!
Indeed!!
And now I am also the Supreme Commander of the Resistance!
I have watched your battles so far!
But they were an utter disgrace!! I shall whip you back into shape myself!
Please wait, Master!
They're exhausted from their long journey and battle after battle!
Fool!! The enemy will not wait for you!
Have you forgotten our mission--to liberate this continent as swiftly as possible?!

Rain!
Prepare the arena!
Y-Yes, sir...!
An arena...? What's that supposed to mean...

rows.notes: Master Asia's gender is blank in speakers.tsv: Rain, Jiron and Kanji's lines avoid he/she (segs 6, 10, 19). [jp] = 'Master'. Seg 18: [jp] ([jp], a Zen-style shout) rendered as a shout 'HAAAAAH!'. Seg 29: Rain's [jp] to Master Asia = 'R-right away...!' (no sir/ma'am). | [editorial 10] Master Asia now known male: pronoun workaround 'The commander' smoothed to 'He' | [editorial 29] Rain's [jp] to Master Asia: consistent with row 14 k8 'Ah, yes, sir!' now his gender is known | [proofread 14] punctuation: question mark added to the shouted question (style '?!')

segments.en: Hm? Sure is noisy... What's about to start?
Maybe I'll find out something if I go to the bridge.
I'm sorry this came up so suddenly...
No... it's fine.
Everyone! A chance to spar with Master Asia! You won't get another opportunity like this!
Heh! It ain't any fun unless it's at least that tough!
That's right. Let's show 'em what we've got!
Kanji, you up for this?
Hand-to-hand training, huh... I'm not too keen on it...
Kanji! Don't say such pathetic things--you're a man, aren't you!
H-Hey, hold on a sec! I'm a pilot through and through! Slugging it out isn't my...
Quit whining and come on!!
Waaaah!!

Hahahaha!
Allll right!
Let's do this!!
That captain... a woman, and yet she speaks with admirable spirit.

Heh...
Shall we begin, then?
Select "Depart" to begin the "Hand-to-Hand Combat" drill.
Note that the "Infantry Squad" cannot be edited in Story Mode.

rows.notes: Seg 9: Elchi's [jp] kept at full force. Seg 16: [jp] = 'Hand-to-Hand Combat' (previous table's term), [jp] menu option = 'Depart' (earlier tutorial slice). Seg 17: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (UI term). | [proofread 13] style sheet 'All right' (not 'Alright'): stretched 'Alllright' -> 'Allll right', matching the corpus's stretched form | [proofread 15] punctuation: question mark on 'Shall we...' question

segments.en:
Inside the Resistance Base
"Infantry Squad" Drill
Ladies and gentlemen, the wait is over!
At last, the curtain is about to rise on an unofficial bout of the Continental Fighting Tournament!
A grand event, suspended by the Grados invasion!
It may not be a proper tournament, but it's a battle royal with an all-star lineup!
A dream showdown you'll hardly ever get to see--truly a miracle card!!
And now, the match is about to begin!
Who'd have thought we'd get to see an exhibition match in a place like this? This is the best!
Yeah, this makes staying alive worth it!

Go, everyone!
Do your best!!
Man... this is... one heck of a crowd they've got going.
And this is supposed to be training. That commander... is even worse than "the Sarge."
Hahaha... You said it! Well, lucky for us, we get to watch from the sidelines.
This event is giving the Resistance's morale a huge boost.
On top of that, it helps us blend smoothly into the Resistance...
That man, Master Asia... he's quite the leader...

Hmm~
Is that so?
What? Didn't they take you in here for a while, Chan?
Huh? Well, yeah, but... you know me... I can't think that far ahead...
'Cause you're a dummy, that's why!

Heh...
I guess I am...
...Hmph!
Hahaha... Hey, look! The match is gonna start!

Kanjiii!
Go get 'em!
You're representing Londo Bell, y'know!
Ugh... That Kaine sure has it easy...
Everybody around me is incredible...
Why do I have to be in a match like this......

rows.notes: Seg 2: [jp] = 'Continental Fighting Tournament' (previous table). Seg 7: [jp] = 'exhibition match'. Seg 11: [jp] = 'the Sarge' -- presumably a drill sergeant from the Dragonar pilots' past; could not verify which character, kept generic. Seg 12: [jp] = watching from the sidelines. Seg 15: Amuro's [jp] states the gender, so 'he'. | [editorial 15] project decision: [jp] = 'Master Asia' outside his own intro

segments.en: And now, everyone, all together!

Gundam Fight!
Ready... GO!!
Fwahahaha!
Don't hold back! Come at me with all you've got!!
Whoa... Master Asia sure looks tough...
What're you doing?! Hurry up and give the orders!
Kanji! This is no time to get cold feet!
Hey, wait... did I just get made the commander without anyone asking me?
Why not? We're counting on you, Kanji.
Anyway, isn't Rag better suited for this kind of thing...
I'd rather be up front, see.
Even if you put it like that...
Just do it the same way you would when commanding the Mech Squad.
This is a drill. You don't have to be afraid of failing.

Right...
Got it.
Okay! Win or bust, here we go!!
Yeah!

<Win Condition>
Destroy the enemy vehicles within the time limit.

<Note>
Losing will not result in a Game Over.

rows.notes: Seg 4: subject restored as 'Master Asia' to avoid a gendered pronoun (gender blank in speakers.tsv). Seg 12: [jp] = 'mech squad' (UI term). Seg 15: [jp] = 'win or bust'. Seg 17: [jp] = '<Win Condition>' as in the previous table. | [editorial 12] UI term capitalised: Mech Squad (accuracy flag)

segments.en: Hmph! You're better than I expected.
Well, it would be dull otherwise! You'll be worth the training.
Phew... Guess we pulled it off somehow.
Kanji, impressive as ever.
Yeah...! That was a great plan!
W-Well, gee~ It's all thanks to everyone.
Obtained 10000 funds as the winner's prize.
Thanks to the hand-to-hand training, the trainees' Warrior levels rose slightly.
Well done, all of you! That will be all for today's training!
Leave the maintenance of your ships and machines to the staff here, and rest well.
Tomorrow, we'll review our upcoming operations.
Key members, please come to the operations room!
There you have it.
Dismissed!!
(A strategy meeting, huh... I'd better not oversleep.)
Going straight to my room to rest seems like a waste... I think I'll take a walk around the base.

rows.notes: Seg 5: [jp] = 'Warrior level' ([jp] = Warrior as in the previous table). Seg 10: [jp] (Master Asia after Rain) = 'There you have it.' (no pronoun for Rain, gender blank). Seg 13: volitional [jp] read as Kanji to himself. | [editorial 4] money message aligned to 'Obtained 10000 funds.' while keeping [jp]

segments.en: Hmph! You still need far more training!

Phew...
We couldn't win...
Sorry, everyone...
You just had bad luck this time. Do better next time, that's all.
Thanks to the hand-to-hand training, the trainees' Warrior levels rose slightly.
Tomorrow, we'll review our upcoming operations.
Key members, please come to the operations room!
There you have it.
Dismissed!!
(A strategy meeting, huh... I'd better not oversleep.)
Going straight to my room to rest seems like a waste... I think I'll take a walk around the base.

rows.notes: Losing branch of row 8; shared lines kept identical. | [editorial 3] doubled 'just'; Domon's gruff consolation reads more naturally

segments.en:
Hm...?
What's that...
I've never seen this machine before...
Is it one the Resistance uses...? Doesn't look like an SPT or a WM (Walker Machine), though...
This machine is an RV (Round Vernian).
Round Vernian?
It's the main weapon the Gaia Army used!
I see... SPTs were originally Grados machines, after all...
If they're built on this continent, does the base have a lot of them deployed?
No... Most of them were lost in the fighting so far.
The big production plants were all either destroyed or occupied, too...
I hate to admit it, but Grados weapons are top-notch.
These here are the newest RVs, but without specs in this class, we couldn't even put up a decent fight...
I see...
By the way, who are you guys?
Ah... I'm Roddy Shuffle.
Um... Right now I'm the Vifam's pilot.
I'm Barts Lyan. Same as him, an RV pilot. Nice to meet you!
I'm Kanji Akatsuki. I only just got here, so I'm sure I'll be relying on you a lot.
Nice to meet you.
Sure, let's do our best together!

Heyyy!
Roddy! Barts!
Huff, huff, huff...

...Honestly!
What is with you two?!
We don't have even the tiniest bit of time to slack off!
Here I am, working my hardest...!
...and you won't help me one bit!
Besides, you two were the ones who invited me to join the Resistance!
You ought to show actions that live up to those words, and...
Sorry about that, Squad Leader!
Oh... Kanji! This guy is the leader of our Janous Team.
Huh? Kanji--you mean the Iron Gear's veteran pilot?
Yeah, that's me. Though I haven't served long enough to be called a veteran.
I-I-I-I'm terribly sorry!
I-I'm Scott Heyward, and I have the honor of serving as leader of the Janous Team!
I'll work myself to the bone to take Gaia back from the Grados Army! I look forward to working with you!

Oh, uh...
Likewise.
Wow~ What a thrill! I always read about the Iron Gear crew's exploits in the newspaper!
The newspaper?
Yes, an underground newspaper that circulates within the Resistance.
Lately it's all anyone talks about--what you and your crew have done, Kanji.
After Timp and Horla, you drove off Gosterro's army too! Man~ that felt so great!
More importantly, Scott, didn't you come here for something?

Ahh!
I forgot...!
Come on, Roddy, Barts! Back to your posts!
We don't have a single minute or second to waste!
Yeah, yeah!
Kanji, if you ever need our strength, just call on us anytime.
It was great talking with you today! Well then, if you'll excuse me!
Those guys... They're only 14 or 15, right...
Kids that age are volunteering for this...

rows.notes: [jp] = 'Janous Squad' (glossary ship Janous). [jp] = 'Vifam'. [jp] / [jp] = 'the Gaia army' / 'Gaia' (Gaia Continent per previous table). [jp] (Roddy, Barts, Scott) = plain 'Kanji'; [jp] = 'Scott'. [jp] = 'Squad Leader'. Seg 27: [jp] -- Roddy and Barts invited Scott (and the crew) to join; 'you two' used since [jp] addresses both. Seg 41: [jp]/[jp]/[jp] = Timp/Horla/Gosterro (glossary). | [accuracy 35] project term: the Grados Army (capitalised) | [editorial 34] awkward relative clause 'I'm X, who has...' | [editorial 35] calque 'so I look forward to...' split into two natural sentences | [editorial 48] [jp] as natural English leave-taking | [proofread 5] style sheet: army name capitalised when it names the force ('the Grados Army' pattern) | [proofread 23] punctuation: question mark added to the exclamatory question (style '?!')

segments.en: ...Anyway, I'm just glad everyone's safe.
Heh heh! As if we'd go down that easily!
Still, we've lost yet another base.
Yeah... Eiji must've had the hardest time of all back there. It's amazing he made it back to us.
That's because some of my Resistance comrades stayed behind. The credit goes to them.
More importantly, we got data on a new enemy from this string of battles.
The Grados Army's unmanned machines have gone up another level in performance.
You mean those unmanned machines called Terminator Police...?

Yeah...
Take a look at this.
The "Terminator Police" is a new unmanned machine modified from the unmanned weapon "Skull Gunner."
Like the "Skull Gunner," it can take on an SPT as an equal, and it can be set for all kinds of missions as needed.
It's a machine designed more for anti-personnel use than for fighting mobile weapons.
A heartless killing machine... It's an unforgivable weapon.
But hey, I've heard all that before, y'know?
...Seems there's more to the story.
Fighting them this time, I could tell... They're definitely stronger than in the last battle.
I can't imagine unmanned machines improving that much in performance...
It's not that they're a new model, right?
No... It's not as if new models were sent from the Grados homeworld.
Besides, the Grados Army that came down to the Terra Realm can only modify them so much.
So the enemy getting stronger is down to a software update... is that it?
Most likely, they're growing the AI based on actual combat experience in the Terra Realm.
An AI that grows, huh...
Until we know just what enemy forces are stationed on Terra, we'd better stick to guerrilla warfare as before...
Man, this is frustrating.
Indeed... However... for now, as Eiji says, we have no choice but to endure.
I'll reexamine our strategy based on the new info Eiji gathered for us.
I'm counting on you.
Okay, I'll go talk it over with the commander right away.
Oh?
Um... It's Kanji, isn't it?
Just "Kanji" is fine, Vice-Commander, ma'am!
Oh, cut out the "Vice-Commander" stuff. Just call me "Rain." And you don't need to be so formal, either.
I only ended up as "Vice-Commander" because of how things turned out.
Yeah, I can kinda tell.
Then from now on, I'll call you "Rain."
Uh, s-sure... (sweat)
Still, you sure switch gears fast, Kanji...
Well, yeah. You never really seemed like a superior officer to me, Rain, right from the start.
Right from the start...?!
Well, it depends on the person, but when I think I can get away with it, I test the waters right off the bat.
Besides, I'm used to getting yelled at by superiors.
Sigh... I knew it... So that's how I come across.
After all, I'm just a mechanic. In other words, a jack-of-all-trades...
That's so mean... I'm working hard too, you know...

Ha ha...
This is awkward...
Just kiddiiing!
Huh?!
Hehe... As if something like that would get me down.
Still, that did sting a little~
Aw, sorry, sorry!
I don't feel any sincerity in thaaat~
Really, it was my fault. I'll treat you to something... so forgive me, okay?
Hehe... Good attitude. But there aren't any decent shops on this base.

Oh...
Is that right...
Then how about whenever the chance comes up? Can I put it on my tab till then?
Sure... Once we drive Grados off the continent, the towns should come back to life.
Oh, no! I've got a meeting with the commander now.

See you,
Kanji!

segments.en: Guess I'll turn in soon...

Get some rest
Not yet
Time to hit the sack...

Mmm...
I'm gonna sleep like a log~...

Nah...
I'm still not sleepy...

rows.notes: Seg 1 is the two-option choice ([jp] / [jp]), kept on two lines. | [proofread 5] ellipsis consistency: 22 dots is not a whole number of ellipses; 3 dots per source ellipsis (8) | [proofread 6] ellipsis consistency: 32 dots is not a whole number of ellipses; 3 dots per source ellipsis (12)

segments.en: Zzz... zzz...
The briefing will begin shortly.
Will the chiefs of all sections please assemble in the operations room.
I repeat...
Mmm... I hear such a soothing voice~...
Snore... snore...
30 minutes later...
Zzz... zzz...
Hey, you!! Kanjiii!! What do you think you're doing?!!

Riieee~
I'm still sleepy~
Gaaah!! Quit sleep-talking!! Get up already!!
Mmm... nnn...

You blasted
FOOOOOL!
Gwah!!
The strategy meeting has already started!! Get out here this instant!!

Sorry!!
I'll be right there!!

Oh crap!!
I overslept!
Anyway, I've gotta hurry to the conference room!

rows.notes: Seg 9: [jp] = Kanji mistaking Elchi for his sister Rie (glossary) in his sleep. Seg 8/10: Elchi's rough dialect ([jp] / [jp]) rendered as shouting. Seg 17: [jp] = 'conference room' (source wording, though Rain said [jp]). | [proofread 8] punctuation: doubled form for the shouted question ('?!!' per style sheet)

segments.en: I'm terribly sorry, sir!! Kanji Akatsuki, reporting late!!
You fool!
Ow ow ow ow...!
Late on your very first day! To think you would make light of ME!
Or are you saying yesterday's training wasn't enough to fire up your spirit?!
Not at all, sir!! I was slacking off, sir!!
Hmph! I have no time to lecture you now!
Rain! We begin!!
Ah, yes, sir!
Honestly... Don't embarrass me like that!
Heh... I've got no excuse...
Pff-hehehehe...
Hehehehe...
Hey... We really... shouldn't laugh...
Pfft-hehe... I-I can't breathe...
These guys... What's so funny?
W-Well, that's 'cause you... Heh, heh-heh...
Hmm?
Hey... It's starting.
Now then, to begin, I'll explain the overall situation of the Grados Army.
"Complete Map of the Terra Realm"
So this is a map of the whole Terra Realm.
Yes, that's right. And where we are right now is here, on the "Gaia Continent."
I see... We've still only seen a tiny part of the Terra Realm, haven't we...
Now I'll lay the Grados sphere of influence over it.
Whoa! All of Gaia is occupied by Grados?!
The Asia Continent next door looks like it's hanging by a thread, too.
As you can see, from its base on the southern Cusco Continent, the Grados Army...
...has brought nearly all of the Gaia Continent under its control.
Furthermore, the Grados Army has begun invading the Asia Continent and already holds 70% of Asia.
Grados came to this planet to rule all of Terra. If we leave them alone, the Terra Realm will...
...end up entirely occupied by Grados, you mean?
But hey, every continent has a powerful army. I don't think it'll be that easy for them.
But it's Eiji saying this, and he came from Grados. Don't you think we can trust that?
Indeed. After all, Gaia actually has been conquered.
The Grados Army doesn't just push through with brute force.
Their strategy begins with stirring up civil war inside each continent.
Strike all at once when civil war has worn them down... That's basic military strategy.
Exactly. By the time anyone notices, they've lost the strength to resist Grados.
They used the same trick when they occupied this continent.
What's serious is that Grados controls the information, so the truth about this country barely reaches the other continents.
Then shouldn't we let the other continents know about this, and fast?
We're sending our comrades out to each continent, a few at a time.
But there are only a few of them, and on the other continents they can't move around very freely.
We need to tell people of Terra's crisis and gather lots of allies, and yet...
Then that makes it easy. We can move fairly freely even on other continents, after all.
We'll take on that mission!
Fwahahahaha! Most reassuring, Captain Elchi!
But do not be hasty. First, hear what I have to say!
Right now, their long advance into Asia has stretched their supply lines to the limit.
For the Grados home base lies beyond the space gate that opens in the sky above Cusco.
However, if the Gaia Continent falls completely into the Grados Army's hands...
...they will turn this continent into a supply base, and invading Asia will become far easier than it is now.
Therefore, our guerrilla activities in Gaia must continue.
So as long as we keep resisting, the enemy can't secure a proper supply base on this continent.
In time, the Iron Gear will set out for the other continents. But for now, securing our foothold comes first.
Listen well!! The operation I am about to explain has two objectives!
The first is to show the enemy that there is NO Resistance base in this area!
To that end, we will fight farther away from the base.
And the other objective is to seize enemy supplies and strengthen our forces even further!
The target: a Grados Army supply unit bound for the Asian front!
It will be escorted, without fail. Go in prepared!
That is all! These operations will be carried out with the Iron Gear at their core!
Any questions?
Ve~ry well!! Then take your positions at once!!

segments.en: Little Kanji! Is somebody still sweepy-weepy?
Ugh... Knock it off, will you? I already got chewed out plenty after the briefing...
Ha ha! My condolences!
But you know, it's already the talk of the whole base.
Huh...? What's that supposed to mean?
Thing is, what you said when Elchi woke you up... everyone in the operations room heard it.
What? Seriously...?! ...Then that means...
Riiie~ I'm still sleepy~
Bwahahahaha!! This guy always has little Rie wake him up~!
Eeeek!! S-Stop it!!
Hm? Hey... Kanji.
...Looks like that really hit you hard.
The worst blunder of my life... This hurts more than any lecture...
This Rie... is she your... girlfriend?
Gugh!!
No way, of course not! She's my little sister!
...Your sister? I see...
Eiji, what's wrong? You suddenly got all serious...
I'm sorry... for dragging you all into this fight.
Wh-What's this, all of a sudden...
Once the Grados business is settled, I'll lend you all my strength! I promise.
See you! I'm counting on you to set up the squads, Kanji.
Ah, Eiji!
He took off.
Eiji's more considerate than he looks, huh.
Hmm...
Hey! You there! Keep those hands moving!
Whoa! Sorry, sir!
See ya, Kanji!
Kanji, how's the setup of the new squads coming along?
Well... I'm just about to start.
Sorry... Oversleeping and all... Maybe it's 'cause I'm getting used to things, but I've gotten a bit slack lately...
Getting used to things... in a situation like this... You're really something, you know.
This fight is going to be a long one. Don't push yourself too hard.
I know.
Once the squads are set up, we depart. I'm leaving the rest to you.
Roger!
Okay, time to start the Squad Setup.
Hmm... The question is what kind of enemies we'll run into...
Oh, if that's what you're wondering, probably... Grados patrols or hired Breakers, I'd say.
Here! This is the data on 'em.
Thanks!
Huh, I see... That's helpful.
Say, Kanji... I got told to set up the "Infantry Squad."
So, uh... I'd like to borrow your terminal now and then.
Yeah, no problem.
Then I'll leave it here when I'm done, so go ahead and use it whenever.
Heh, thanks a bunch.

rows.notes: Seg 0: Kaine's baby talk ([jp]) rendered as 'sweepy-weepy'. Seg 7: Tapp parodies Kanji's sleep-talk from row 13 (Rie~). Seg 8: [jp] -> 'little Rie' (-chan dropped). [jp] -> 'set up the squads' / 'Squad Setup' per UI decision. | [editorial 27] [jp] rendered literally and stiffly | [proofread 17] ellipsis consistency: 19 dots is not a whole number of ellipses; 3 dots per source ellipsis (7)

segments.en: The Grados supply unit is heading for the Asian front by land.
If we lie in wait near Paradigm City, we're bound to run into the supply unit.
Got it. So we just need to get near Paradigm City.
Blume! Bring up the marker and set our course!
You got it!
Iron Gear, move out!
Hm? What's this?
Elchi! We're getting a transmission from somewhere close by.
Out here?
Hi~! You there, the ones coming this way...
I'm kinda out of gas and in a bit of a jam~
Could you give me a lift to Paradigm City?
Um, or if that's too much, just sharing some propellant would be fine too~
Looks like a civilian.
Probably a private hauler or something of the sort.
Looks like she doesn't know we're wanted yet!
Then we'd better not get involved...
Even just talking with us could make her a target for Grados or the Breakers...
Hey! Hello!! Can you hear me or not?!
Hey! Come on! Wait up!!
Elchi~
Yeah... I do feel kinda sorry for her...
Let's at least leave her some fuel.
You're right... Running out of gas in a wasteland like this is rough...
That's our Elchi! Okay, I'll go!
Hold it! I'm coming too!
Huh? It's fine, I can do it by myself.
You're such a softie, you were gonna go out of your way and take it right up to her, weren't you?
Yeah! That's the idea, but...
Honestly... You just don't get the situation.
Listen. All you've gotta do is toss it off the rear deck.
Okay, okay.
Hnngh!
Hup!
Hey there! I'm leaving it here! You'll have to come pick it up yourself!
Hey! Don't shout!
Oh... Right.
What's that...? Don't tell me that's fuel?
Wait, so I'm supposed to walk all the way over there to get it?
...Geez! Every last one of 'em... The people on this continent are rotten to the core!
I wonder if that was the right thing to do...

rows.notes: Seg 11: [jp] has no stated subject; read as the civilian (Faye) being targeted for contacting the wanted Iron Gear, rendered 'make her a target'. Could also mean 'we' could be targeted; not certain.

segments.en: This is D-3! I've spotted the enemy supply unit!
Full speed ahead! Don't let our prey get away!
Aye aye!!
Man, escorting a supply unit is one boring assignment.
Now, don't say that. There's a lot of resistance types around here.
Ain't this where those Breaker thugs are supposed to be prowling around?
Can't even tell 'em apart from the Resistance!
The Breakers won't lay a finger on us. We're the Grados Army!
By the way, where are we hauling this cargo?
Ah... It's going to Commander Arthea of the Western Army.
Tch! Commander Arthea... You mean the one in the iron mask!
Whoa, whoa... That's the commander of an allied nation you're talking about.
The Galfa Empire of the planet Arktos is an ally with diplomatic ties to the government of the Grados homeworld.
Commander Arthea is taking part in this expedition as Arktos's representative, you know.
I just don't like some alien from another planet bossing around the elite of the Grados Army!
Just 'cause he's Lord Gresco's favorite... I hope it doesn't go to his head!
Well, yeah...
Anyway, all we've gotta do is deliver the cargo safe and sound.
We're counting on you for the escort, chief!
I know. We'll scatter any small fry that show up.
What?! That's artillery fire!!
Ah... That's...!
A red Land Ship... The Iron Gear from the files!!
E-Enemy... Enemy attack!!
Don't panic! Battle stations!!

rows.notes: Seg 10/15: Arthea referred to as 'he/his' per glossary (male). [jp] -> 'chief' (security member addressing the escort soldier). [jp] -> Arktos (term_fixes). [jp] -> 'resistance types'.

segments.en: Anyway, stop that enemy mothership in its tracks.
Then we'll storm aboard and take it over!
OK! I'll leave that to you.
Mech Squad, follow me!!
We are soldiers of the Grados regular army! There's no way we could lose to a bunch of guerrillas!
This can't be happening!!
Ah... Ahh... It's... hopeless...
But... we can't let the Resistance get their hands on these supplies! Burn it all!!
Whoa! That's far enough.
Who the hell are you people?!!
Hup-pa!!
Urgh!
This is the ground team. We've secured the supplies. Let's hurry with the loading.
Good work! Everyone! Give us a hand with the loading!

rows.notes: [proofread 3] punctuation: doubled form for the shouted question ('?!!' per style sheet)

segments.en: Now that the cargo's loaded, there's no point sticking around. We're heading back to base.
Roger!
The base is in sight.
And that wraps up our first mission without a hitch.
Before we go into the base, keep a sharp eye out for enemy recon units.
I know. I've got Kaine and the others on patrol.
We sure have been getting a lot of patrol duty lately, huh.
Quit griping! Ours are high-performance machines, so it can't be helped!
Light! I guess we can call it all clear for now, right?
Nothing on any of the sensors. Looks like we're fine.
All right! Let's head back to the ship!

rows.notes: [accuracy 5] superlative added: JP says the machines are high-performance, not 'the best'

segments.en: Grados City
What?!
Our supply unit has been wiped out?!
My deepest apologies, Lord Le Caine!!
However, only part of the unit was destroyed.
It will have little effect on supplies to the front.
Naturally!
The problem is that our army was made fools of by Resistance scum, those gutter rats!
I will hold you accountable later. For now, devote all your efforts to bringing the situation under control!!
Yes, sir!!
I have barely taken command... and they pull this......
But I will not let them have their way any longer!
Roanne Demitrich, entering!!
Lord Le Caine! Congratulations on your appointment as Commander of the Terra Invasion Force!!
Heh... So you are the Terran who is supposedly useful?
I'm honored!
Grados is now my mother planet.
Whatever I can do, you need only command it!
I wish to be of service, Commander, sir!
The Gaia Continent still has far too many fools...
I hear the Resistance attacked one of our supply units a short while ago.
However, now that I am commander, every last one of that rabble shall be annihilated.
Splendid. That gathering of imbeciles should be wiped out as soon as possible.
The only reason they cannot accept the superior culture of Grados is that their character is base.
Precisely, Roanne Demitrich.
I intend to show them how meaningless it is to cling to Terran culture...
...and to impart to them the sublimity of Grados culture.
Yes, sir!
I hear that, in order to preserve the old Terran culture...
...a woman attempted to resist not by force of arms, but through culture...
Yes, sir. She is currently confined in a special cell.
She is scheduled to be executed tomorrow morning... Is there some concern, sir?
True... It is a trifling matter.
But that woman... in the decisive battle fought in the skies over Gaia three years ago...
...she is said to be a survivor of the group that pressed our forces the hardest.
I am told she was one of those who challenged us alongside the Grados-Terran half-breed, Eiji Asuka.
Yes, sir! Eiji Asuka is still defying Grados as a leader of the Resistance.
And the woman's name is Anna Stephanie.
Though she has no connection with the Resistance...
...in refusing to submit to Grados policy, she is no different from them.
I have received reports that you, too, were one of them three years ago.
Just as you say, sir! Three years ago, I fought Grados alongside them.
But we lost that fight.
And yet, what they are doing now is nothing but folly that threatens the peace.
Never putting the wars of the past behind them, stirring up needless strife... I am deeply disappointed in them!
This woman, Anna... She was once your comrade, was she not? Can you execute her?
To be honest, carrying it out with my own hands weighs on me...
...but so long as she will not change her mind, it cannot be helped...
I believe that disposing of her by my own hand is the least mercy I can show her.
Very well. This task seems ideal for you.
Yes, sir! Command me as you will.
Listen. Spread word of Anna's execution far and wide.
Postpone the execution until the Resistance takes the bait.
With you, a native of Gaia, taking command in person, the effect will be doubled!
I will make the Terrans realize how worthless the things they have believed in are.
A brilliant plan, sir. She will be perfect bait to lure out the Resistance.
And if the Resistance doesn't come to save Anna, they will lose the people's support.
Heh heh... It seems there is no need for me to explain any further.
I will do my utmost!
Roanne Demitrich! I do not desire pointless bloodshed.
If this Anna changes her mind in the meantime, so much the better.
I will allow you to take her on as your subordinate.
I am grateful for your consideration, sir.

rows.notes: Roanne's gender left unstated (glossary blank): no he/she used for Roanne. [jp] -> Terran(s) per project decision. [jp] -> 'Resistance scum, those gutter rats'. [jp] -> 'half-breed' (Le Caine's contempt). | [accuracy 38] referent: [jp] is Eiji, but the old wording put 'the half-breed' where it could read as the woman; hearsay [jp] restored | [editorial 19] stiff 'Command me in anything that I am able to do!' (accuracy flag) | [proofread 10] ellipsis consistency: 16 dots is not a whole number of ellipses; 3 dots per source ellipsis (6) | [proofread 20] ellipsis consistency: 16 dots -> 18 (3 per source ellipsis, 6)

segments.en: Resistance Base
Hey! You there! Quit dawdling!
There's still plenty more cargo, you know!
Let's work smart! Hup!!
Hey! Kaine!!
I told you to be careful with the containers! There are missiles and stuff in there!
Still, that's a lot of stuff. Can't believe it all fit...
Isn't that 'cause it was a hauler's ship to begin with?
And this is all loot, huh. Guess the ones who have it really have it.
Thanks to everyone, the operation was a success.
With these spoils, we can make up for the supplies the Resistance was short on.
And it should have helped our comrades fighting in Asia, too.
Eiiijiii!!
Eiji! It's terrible!!
Hm?
If I remember right, those guys are... ......?!
It's the three from the Janous Team... Did something happen...?
Hah, hah, hah, hah...
H-Hey, calm down. What happened?
I'll tell you.
Eiji! The Culture Correction Squad has Anna...
They say Anna's going to be executed soon...!
Anna?! Is that true?!
It's from our people in the city. It's 100% certain.
Oh no... To think Anna had been captured...
Apparently the Grados guys are spreading it all over town!
Saying we in the Resistance are a bunch of cowards who can't even save one girl...
Anna's not in the Resistance! So why...!
To them, any excuse will do. Makes my blood boil!
So when is the execution?
We don't know... But we're going to rescue Anna.
Don't! It's a trap!
They're trying to lure us out.
Even so, we can't just sit here and do nothing.
Three years ago, in the decisive battle, Anna was one of the people who joined Eiji in the last counterattack...
Everyone on this continent knows that.
Th-That's right! If we back down now, we'll lose the people's support!
I know... That's why I'll go alone!
Don't be stupid! That way neither you nor Anna will make it out!
We'll have a better chance of success if we go all out here!
First, let's at least talk it over with Master Asia or Rain.
I'm on board with that too! You are too, right, Roddy?
No matter what anyone says, we're going!
Anna was looking after my little brother, Fred.
I can't just abandon her!
Whoa, whoa... Don't get so prickly.
That's right... Roddy... you have your little brother, Fred.
Right! I'll go talk to Master Asia right away.
Um! Kanji, you're in charge of the Iron Gear's Squad Setup, right?
Could you assign the Janous Team to the Iron Gear?
Put the Janous Team in with the Iron Gear?
Yes... Please.
...All right.
But I can't decide that on my own. I'll talk it over with the commander.
Please!
Eiji, let's go.
Right!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Master Asia' (the Resistance commander); no glossary/decision for [jp] -- please unify across slices. [jp] -> 'Janous Team' (glossary [jp] Janous). [jp] -> 'Culture Correction Squad' (as in 3983_09438). Anna referred to without honorific ([jp]). | [editorial 15] awkward word order for [jp]

segments.en: Oh, Kanji! Master Asia is waiting for you in the operations room.
Ah... Thanks. Well, let's go.
...So that's the situation, sir. Would you consider this operation plan?
Hmm... Grados means to use this girl Anna as a decoy to lure us out...
...and you intend to leap right into that trap, knowing it is one.
Yes...
Hmm... Charging in when the enemy's strength is unknown is the height of folly!
But... the power that people hold within cannot be reduced to numbers!
I shall give you my conclusion first! We cannot stake the full strength of the Resistance on this!
But neither shall we stand idly by!
Then...!
Take the Iron Gear and launch a raid on Grados City!
Show Grados that true justice is on our side!!
Wh-Whoa...!
I'll contact everyone.
You two, help out with the machine maintenance.
Understood.
And Kanji, please assign the Janous Team to the Iron Gear.
Really? But they're still...
Oh... Were you against it, Kanji?
Assigning them is fine... But having them take part in this operation, I'm not so sure...
Because they are children?
No, sir... It's just that we haven't even trained with them yet.
They have been gaining combat experience since before you came here. They will surely prove useful.
Understood. I'll assign the Janous Team.
Good... Begin preparing to sortie at once!
Roger!
Roddy, Barts and Scott have joined the unit.
The Vifam SP and Neofam have been deployed.

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Master Asia' (seg 0). [jp] -> 'Vifam SP' (glossary has only [jp] Vifam/Sling Panier; SP = Sling Panier).

segments.en: Is this the place? Where they're holding the woman from the resistance...
Oh, she's hardly what you'd call a resistance fighter.
She was just reading old books against policy. She's nobody special.
The rotten culture of this continent must be eliminated immediately!
Even if she bears no weapons, she is still criticizing Grados policy all the same.
Ah... Indeed...
She was scheduled to be executed tomorrow morning...
...but thanks to Lord Le Caine's consideration, I have been permitted to try persuading her.
Persuading... her?
For what it's worth, she is an old acquaintance of mine.
I'd like to give her one last chance to swear loyalty to Grados.
Understood. I'll undo the lock now.
Who are you...?
It's been a long time, Anna.
Huh...?
Roanne... Is that you, Roanne?!
But that uniform...
Yes... I now have a job of some standing here in Grados City.
Then the rumor that you're a Grados official... is it true?
Oh~? So that's become a rumor, has it?
But I don't think I've done anything special.
Roanne! What do you mean by that?
We were comrades who fought Grados together with Eiji, weren't we?
And yet... to talk like that... It's as if...
Anna, this continent lost the war against Grados.
Grados is the new order of the Gaia Continent.
If you'd just forget the last war and quietly obey Grados, you could live a much better life.
Roanne... Explain yourself! I can't believe this!
To you, as you are now, I'm a traitor...
Nothing you say at this point is going to sting me.
Why...? Why would you, of all people, side with Grados...
Throw away your worthless pride and become a Gradosian, the sooner the better.
If you do, there is a way for you to be saved.
What?
I hardly think there's anything to consider.
Gradosians are superior in every respect.
If you threw yourself in among them, you would see that clearly, too.
Roanne... How could you...
I can't say there's plenty, but there's still time.
If you change your mind, call for me.

rows.notes: Roanne's gender left unstated. Roanne's switch from formal [jp] (with Le Caine) to polite [jp]/[jp] with Anna kept as smooth, condescending politeness. [jp] -> 'Gradosian'. | [editorial 9] [jp] = downplaying, not 'after all' (accuracy flag) | [editorial 33] dangling 'quickly' at end | [editorial 36] 'think... think over' repetition | [proofread 32] ellipsis consistency: 16 dots -> 18 (3 per source ellipsis, 6)

segments.en: Iron Gear, depart! Set course for Grados City!
Aw, the heck with it! Might as well go all in! Off we go, right into the heart of the enemy!
What's the matter, Blume? Scared?
You guys are the ones who've lost it!
You think so? We keep getting more friends, and I'm all excited!
I feel like... I could do something really big.
Something big, huh~
I'll say this to you all, so mark it well!
The Iron Gear's strength alone cannot drive back the Grados Army.
But the enemy cannot get the measure of our strength. That is our opening!
Therefore, our tactic this time is hit-and-run!
Once you have achieved your objective, withdraw at once!
Understood. I'll make sure everyone sticks to that.
Good! Now, go forth!!

rows.notes: Seg 0: [jp] -> 'depart' (UI term).

segments.en: We're about to enter the enemy's surveillance area.
All hands, battle stations!
Jamming at max! Ready whenever you are!!
All right, let's charge in!!
Iron Gear, full speed ahead!!
Anna... I'm coming to save you!
Please let us make it in time!
Ah... Miss Anna...
That's awful... Hanging her up in a place like that!
Hey! Let me through!!
Hey! Kid! Don't come any closer!
Then let her down!
Miss Anna was only reading books.
And yet you do this to her?! It's too cruel! Please forgive her!
Not another word! You want to be charged with the same crime?!
Uuh... Miss Anna! Miss Annaaa!!
Fred...
No matter what happens, you have to be strong and live on, Fred!
Stop it!! Please stop!!
Somebody, save Miss Anna!!
How long are you going to leave her like that?
Wouldn't it be better to just kill her and be done with it?
A public execution exists to make an example of someone.
Ending it quickly would have no effect.
Uh... I see...
Good! It seems our guests have arrived.
Guests?
A Land Ship is approaching! It's the Iron Gear, no doubt about it!
Understood. Open a channel to them.

rows.notes: Fred's [jp] / [jp] / [jp] -> 'Miss Anna' (Fred is not Anna's sibling; generic kid's address for a young woman). | [accuracy 13] [jp] ('and yet') restored; [jp] = 'forgive/pardon her' (the crime), not 'let her go' (Fred already asked them to let her down in k11) | [editorial 18] stiff literal 'live strong' smoothed (accuracy flag); meaning kept

segments.en: Eiji. So you came after all.
I won't call it foolish. You people have no other choice left, after all.
But if I may say so, I'd recommend you surrender right now.
Roanne!! Is that you, Roanne?!
So you really did betray us!
I suppose so... from where you all stand now.
But in war, the right path is to follow whoever won.
So if you win, anything goes?!
The Grados Army isn't slaughtering every last Terran, is it?
Grados has welcomed me in, as you can see.
Granted, that's because of my abilities.
But that's surely been true in every age.
People without ability simply haven't made enough effort.
If you ask me, the real problem is a society that tries to coddle even people like that.
It's not too late. If you'd only throw away the past, you could have a position worthy of your abilities.
Why not join the Grados Army and put those skills to good use?
I refuse!
Taking Anna hostage when she can't even fight back... I won't forgive that!
That's right! That's not how a real man fights! Face us fair and square!
Now, now... Don't get the wrong idea.
Anna is no hostage or anything of the sort. The Grados Army has no need for such petty tricks.
This is a show I put on for you people, since you won't fight fair and square. I'd hate for you to get that wrong.
Well, if you want Anna back, you'll have to break through by force.
Roanne... You...!
There's no reason to hesitate! Let's go, Eiji!
If it's a trap, we just chew right through it!
You're right... All right! Let's go!
Yeah!!

rows.notes: Roanne's gender left unstated (glossary blank). Seg 18: Jiron's [jp] kept as 'That's not how a real man fights!' -- the source itself says it, not inferred from a name. Seg 25: [jp] -> 'chew right through it'. | [editorial 17] awkward relative clause smoothed | [editorial 24] 'nothing to hesitate over' stiff for a battle call

segments.en: Impressive, Eiji. Now that I'm fighting you as an enemy, I really see how strong you are.
But Lord Le Caine's designs run far deeper. You people will never stand a chance.
What? Did you say Le Caine?!
You know of him? Well, of course you would.
You were a Gradosian yourself, after all.
Then you understand, don't you? To Lord Le Caine, this battle is nothing more than a warm-up.
Now that he is here, the Grados Army will grow even stronger than it is now.
I don't know what you're talking about, but it just sounds like sour grapes to me!
You said it! Now, Eiji! Go save Anna while you've got the chance!
Right...!

rows.notes: Seg 1: [jp] -> 'You people will never stand a chance' (against Le Caine's plans). | [editorial 4] term consistency: 'Grados people' -> Gradosian (project decision / queued term fix)

segments.en: Anna! I'm coming to save you!!
Oh, Eiji has come for me...
But... you mustn't come now!
Gwaaaaah!!
Eiji!! Are you okay?!
Yeah... Somehow.
Heh heh heh... V-MAX is not the Layzner's specialty alone!
Now, taste it! My baptism of light!!
Whoa!
Th-That's fast!!
What the heck is that?!
The same as Eiji's V-MAX?

rows.notes: Seg 1: Anna's line read as said to herself ('Eiji has come for me'), seg 2 addressed to Eiji. | [proofread 10] punctuation: question mark added to the exclamatory question (style '?!')

segments.en: Le Caine!!
That's Le Caine?!
He's a man who can't tell confidence from conceit.
Looks like he's become the new supreme commander of Grados...
Now that he's here, Grados's grip will only get tighter.
Terrans! Hear me!
You have now seen how foolish it is to stand against me!
Do not defy us! The happiness of you continental people lies in being ruled by us!
The rulers and the ruled. In all the universe, there is no principle but that!
Better rule! Innocent obedience!
This is the one and only truth that will bring forth an ideal world!!
I have come to this land to establish true peace based on that principle.
From this moment on, cast off your old culture entirely. Believe in Grados!
Believe in ME!!
You're wrong!!
This continent... belongs to everyone who lives here!
Only those born and raised in this land can hold this continent up.
That's right! This continent doesn't belong to the Gradosians!
Once Grados is gone, this land will be at peace in no time!
You... Who are you?!
Albatro Null Eiji Asuka!
Eiji... Asuka... The traitor to Grados...!
Hmph! I knew I would meet you sooner or later.
Eiji! Unfortunately, I have no ears for the ravings of one whose blood is tainted!
Le Caine! We're not soft enough to just let you do as you please, either.
Listen well!! I'm a man who came back from the depths of the earth!!
Mark my words: I'll drive you and Admiral Gresco off this continent, no matter what!
Very well! Then prove it with your actions!
Here I come, you Terran rabble!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> Terrans; [jp] -> 'continental people'; [jp] -> Gradosians. [jp] -> 'one whose blood is tainted' (Eiji's mixed heritage). | [accuracy 29] contempt of [jp] restored (same rendering as dlg_4012_09500_01 row 15) | [editorial 14] [jp] answers 'Believe in ME!!' -- 'That's not true' did not fit the retort

segments.en: Dammit! We're this close to saving Anna!!
Le Caine's tough! Everyone, focus on the fight in front of you for now!
Eiji's right. Leave rescuing Anna and Fred to us in the Infantry Squad.
We will bring them both back without fail. Rest assured!
Come on! Anyone who wants to get sent flying, come and get it!
Here they come! Regroup!
Roger!!

rows.notes: [editorial 0] rescue is still under way (k2 hands it to the infantry); past tense read as if it had failed (accuracy flag)

segments.en: All right, we drove off the enemy's first wave.
And we've rescued Anna on our end!
What about Fred?
Don't worry. We got everyone out.
Anna and Fred have been taken aboard the Iron Gear.
With this, the operation's objective has been achieved. There is no reason to linger.
Okay, let's fall back!

rows.notes: [accuracy 1] [jp] = 'we did our part as well' (infantry squad reporting after Kanji's report); 'We rescued Anna too' could read as Anna in addition to someone else

segments.en: You know full well how overwhelming the gap in strength is, yet you take on a reckless fight... What drives you to it?
Le Caine!
Remember this well: fighting for pride is what makes us human!
Today was just to say hello. We'll meet again!
Your Excellency! Our reinforcements have arrived. We can wipe them out in one stroke now!
Your Excellency! Your orders!
All forces, cease the attack!
Yes, sir! I'll issue a cease-fire order to all forces!
Heh heh... Terrans... How interesting...!
This time, in honor of your valiant fight, I shall let you go.
The Gaia Continent... No... This Terra Realm is brimming with fiery thrills!
Fwahahaha!! I like it!!
Fuhahahahahahaha!!

rows.notes: Seg 2: [jp] -> 'fighting for pride is what makes us human'. [jp] -> Terra Realm. | [editorial 11] 'thrilling excitement' redundant; restores the heat of [jp]
